title: Wall Street falls after historic GDP slump, Trump suggests election delay
text: Earlier in the day, official data showed the U.S. economy suffered its steepest contraction since the Great Depression in the second quarter, as business activity came to an abrupt halt on efforts to slow the virus outbreak. Jobless claims numbers also showed another rise in the latest week, adding to signs the momentum of economic recovery has slowed, especially in southern and western U.S. states. The U.S. Federal Reserve on Wednesday acknowledged the surge in cases was likely stalling recovery, while pledging to support the economy as long as necessary, giving a boost to Wall Street's three main indexes late in the session.

title: 3 Tailwinds Are Lifting TSMC’s Stock to New All-Time Highs
text: Intel's 7nm setback Intel (NASDAQ: INTC), TSMC, and Samsung own the world's most advanced chip foundries. Earlier this year, TSMC (NYSE: TSM) was seemingly stuck in a rut after an escalation of the trade war between the U.S. and China forced it to stop accepting orders from Chinese tech giant Huawei, its second largest customer, which accounted for 14% of its revenues in fiscal 2019.
